note: Each agent definition in agents/ names a tier, never a model. Map each tier to the model identifier your harness uses: a model served on your own machine or a hosted one. The checks read this file and run no model.

orchestrator.role: sole write access; plans, decides what to delegate, integrates

subagent.role: read-only subagents: fact-checking, web search, reconciliation, evaluation

helper.role: one closed task whose result one command re-derives
